the use of vulnerability, adaptation and resilience science to support practice is a complex, time-consuming process, which requires a number of steps to be undertaken to ensure that knowledge and understanding is generated and applied to support the needs of the users.

the vulnerability, adaptation, resilience, and disaster risk-reduction science community needs to develop and strengthen its capacity to engage with the practitioner community in order to ensure the relevance and uptake of its research and knowledge in practice, as well as the capacity to learn from the practice community.
